name: NSW Spectacles Program (free glasses)
summary: Free glasses every two years for financially disadvantaged NSW residents on a full Centrelink income support payment or low wages.
key: One pair of single vision glasses or bifocals in any 2-year period.
who: Australian permanent resident living in NSW
Receive a full Centrelink pension or income support payment with no other income, or earn less than the full JobSeeker Payment (under 65)
Financial assets less than $500 (single) or $1,000 (partnered or parent)
Not eligible for any other spectacles subsidy scheme
catches: Asset test is strict; part-rate payment recipients with other income may not qualify.

evidence.quote: free glasses and vision aids to financially disadvantaged NSW residents.
